bullets: Batch Normalization Calculate Mean and Variance of Each Mini-Batch instead of Calculating Mean and Variance of the Whole Data.
The mean and variance will differ from mini-batch to another  (Source of Error).

layout.hierarchy: Title dominates (largest, bold, red). The two colorful 3D cube diagrams are the next most visually dominant elements. The cream callout box draws the eye in the center. Bottom summary text is medium-sized bold; the blue lines read first, then the red line. Slide number badge is small.

visual_elements.description: Left 3D isometric cube stack: a block built of small cubes. Front-left face is a 4x4 grid of magenta/purple cubes; the right-side face shows an orange column slice; the top face shows stacked rows of layers in dark navy, yellow, green, and orange, suggesting a batch of multi-channel feature-map volumes. No text labels on this one.

Right 3D isometric cube stack (same style): front face is a 4x4 grid of magenta/purple cubes; behind it, parallel slices in green, orange, yellow, light blue, and dark navy recede to the upper right, representing batch samples/channels. Annotated with three red double-headed arrows: vertical arrow on the left side labeled 'Feature Vector' (text rotated 90°, reading bottom-to-top), horizontal arrow under the front bottom edge labeled 'Channels', and diagonal arrow along the right receding edge labeled 'Batch size' (text rotated along the diagonal).

Center callout box: cream/light-yellow fill, thin red border, slight drop shadow. Text lines: 'Batch Normalization' (red bold), 'Calculate (then Normalize) μ, σ' (black, with μ and σ in red), 'for ALL Samples in the batch' ('ALL Samples' in bold blue), '(for each channel)' (green, underlined). A small pencil/cursor icon sits at the bottom-left inside the box.

Bottom summary box: white fill, medium green border. Three left-aligned bold paragraphs: line 1 blue ('Batch Normalization Calculate Mean and Variance of Each Mini-Batch instead of Calculating Mean and Variance of the Whole Data.'), line 2 blue with trailing '(Source of Error).' in black ('The mean and variance will differ from mini-batch to another  (Source of Error).'), line 3 red ('Mini Batch Size should be large enough to minimize "batching" effect.  (Constrain)').

recreation_brief: 1. Create a 16:9 slide with white background; draw a dark-red (#990000) rectangle outline inset ~0.15" from all edges as a frame. 2. Add title text box top-center: 'Batch Normalization', Arial bold ~40pt, red #CC0000. 3. Top-right corner: draw a ~0.5" circle, yellow #FFFF00 fill, red outline, with text '43' in red bold ~14pt. 4. Middle-left: insert an isometric 3D cube-stack graphic (build from small cubes: front face 4x4 magenta #CC00CC cubes, right face orange #FF8000 column, top rows in dark navy #223355, yellow #FFFF00, green #00CC00, orange #FF8000); no labels. 5. Middle-center: draw a rectangle ~1/3 slide width, fill cream #FFFDE0, thin red border, subtle shadow; add four left-aligned lines: 'Batch Normalization' (red bold), 'Calculate (then Normalize) μ, σ' (black, μ and σ red), 'for ALL Samples in the batch' (black with 'ALL Samples' bold blue #0000CC), '(for each channel)' (green #009900, bold, underlined); place a small pencil icon at the box's bottom-left. 6. Middle-right: duplicate the cube-stack graphic but add receding slices in green, orange, yellow, light blue #6699CC, and dark navy behind the magenta front face; add three red #CC0000 double-headed arrows with bold red labels: vertical arrow left of the block labeled 'Feature Vector' (rotated 90°), horizontal arrow below the front edge labeled 'Channels', diagonal arrow along the right receding edge labeled 'Batch size' (rotated to match the diagonal). 7. Bottom: draw a full-width rectangle, white fill, green #00AA00 border; inside, three bold ~18pt paragraphs with spacing between: (a) blue #0000CC: 'Batch Normalization Calculate Mean and Variance of Each Mini-Batch instead of Calculating Mean and Variance of the Whole Data.' (b) blue #0000CC: 'The mean and variance will differ from mini-batch to another' followed by black '(Source of Error).' (c) red #CC0000: 'Mini Batch Size should be large enough to minimize "batching" effect.' followed by '(Constrain)'. 8. Optionally add a thin black strip along the very bottom edge to match the source frame.
